objective: Distribute an exact bounded integer-cent total into ordered fresh euro shares.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Integer representations and bounded arithmetic remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Allocating remainders is useful beyond this local bill example.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Input/output size and exact integer invariants are transferable.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The medium stage gives an explicit safe-cent domain.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Large counts and frozen prices prevent truncation and source mutation.

defects: People limits and price precision/domain were unspecified.
The text could be read as promising exact binary floating-point sum of euro outputs.
Capping the number of people and sorting the source passed old checks.
rationale: Specify nonnegative cent-derived Number prices, at most 1000 entries and 1..1000 people. The summed rounded cents remain safe integers; each cent is assigned once to earliest people before euro conversion. Explain that final euro Number addition may still show floating-point error. Include output length in the combined linear target and require fresh arrays. Add 1000 shares for three cents, large totals, empty prices and frozen inputs. No billing/payment configuration or real transaction changes.

objective: Count valid offset timestamps by zero-padded UTC date in first-appearance order.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: UTC conversion and ISO formatting remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Grouping timestamps by instant rather than written local date is practical.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Timezone boundaries and explicit output formatting are transferable.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The authored final hard stage keeps its tier position and scope.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Ancient years, offset rollovers and insertion order expose hidden format assumptions.

defects: Junior UTC formatting omitted leading zeroes for years below 1000.
Timestamp validity/range, ownership and first-appearance ordering lacked complete checks.
Sorting days passed old deep-equality-only assertions.
rationale: Bound valid explicit-offset ISO timestamps with four-digit UTC results, at most 1000 occurrences and fresh ordinary output. Pad junior UTC years to four digits, retaining correct calendar treatment rather than rebuilding dates with the special 0..99 constructor rules. Add year0000/0099/9999 offset results, explicit Object.keys first-seen order and 1000 duplicate timestamps with fresh outputs. Existing timezone contract will also run these authored probes in four non-UTC host zones. Do not broaden to invalid dates or signed extended years.
